title: GoodLevel predicates for projection inputs
statement: For supplied normalized coefficient units, all five projection inputs satisfy GoodLevel at every coefficient level.

proof.text: The finite field of Domains supplies spFiniteConstructibleTor at each level for every object of N, in particular each of the five displayed objects. The right and scalar functors have codomain N.

Use Base.ideals n to transport this finite-level predicate along the actual equality of ell-power and uniformizer-power ideals. Equality induction reduces the transport functor to the identity, so bounded cohomology, intrinsic constructibility, and the Tor interval are unchanged.

If homology vanishes outside the integral interval [a,b], its support is a subset of the finite set of integers in [a,b]. Together with intrinsic constructibility and finite Tor amplitude, this is exactly finiteTorConstructible and hence GoodLevel. Apply this conversion five times.
